findings.label: Malformed SVG star path
findings.description: The SVG <path d='M12 2l2.939 6.326 6.961 0.674-5.07 4.657 1.531 6.843L12 17.027l-6.361 3.473 1.531-6.843L2.1 9.0l6.961-0.674z'> in both Header.astro and Footer.astro uses ambiguous coordinate separators (a minus sign mid-sequence without a preceding comma) that some SVG parsers will misinterpret, and the coordinate sequence does not trace a clean 5-point star. The logo mark will likely render as a distorted or invisible shape. Fix: replace with a well-formed 5-point star path using explicit comma separators, or use a <polygon> element.

findings.label: No independent build log
findings.description: The implementation notes assert 'npm run build — 118 pages built, zero errors, exit code 0' but no build artifact or log file is present to independently verify this. The review was instructed not to re-run the build. This is a process gap; a passing Astro build would not catch the SVG rendering issue since it is static markup.
